lines.japanese: 「そろそろ普通に歩こうか」
lines.english: “Maybe we should walk normally now.”

lines.japanese: 「えっ、なんで？」
lines.english: “What? Why?”

lines.japanese: 恥ずかしいから。
lines.english: Because I was embarrassed.

lines.japanese: 「いや、昔と違ってこれだけ身長差が出来ると、小鳩の肩が疲れちゃうからね、ははは」
lines.english: “Well, we're a lot farther apart in height than we used to be. Your shoulder will get tired, Kobato. Ha ha ha.”

lines.japanese: 「わっ、お兄ちゃん優しい」
lines.english: “Wow, big brother! You’re so thoughtful.”

lines.japanese: 実のところ羞恥心を刺激されたわけじゃない。お巡りさんの警戒心を刺激してしまったのだ。
lines.english: The truth was, this hadn't aroused my sense of shame. It had aroused the local policeman's suspicion.

lines.japanese: さっきから道行く連中の視線が痛い。かわいいけど一見しただけだと幼く見えるからな、うちの妹は。
lines.english: The stares of passersby had been stabbing me for a while now. Adorable though she was, my sister looked awfully young at first glance.

lines.japanese: 「うれしいなあ、ねえねえ抱きついていい？」
lines.english: “I'm so happy. Hey, hey—can I hug you?”

lines.japanese: 「だだだダメに決まってんでしょおー！」
lines.english: “O-o-of course you caaan't!”

lines.japanese: 「あはは、冗談だよ。いくらなんでも道端でそんなこと出来ないよね」
lines.english: “Ha ha, I'm kidding. Even I couldn't do that in the middle of the street.”

lines.japanese: 道端じゃなければいいのかという言葉は飲み込んでおいた。
lines.english: I swallowed the question of whether somewhere off the street would be fine.

lines.japanese: 「お兄ちゃん苦い顔してるけど、どーしたの？　甘いものでも飲む？」
lines.english: “You’re making a bitter face, big brother. What’s wrong? Want something sweet to drink?”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、喉カラカラだし買ってきてもらおうかな。はいじゃあ小鳩の分もお金」
lines.english: “Yeah, my throat's parched. Would you get me something? Here—enough for yours too.”

lines.japanese: 「えっ、いいの？　わーい、じゃあいってきまーす」
lines.english: “Really? Yay! I'll be right back!”

lines.japanese: 陽気に走っていく小鳩は、どこから見ても「微笑ましい」という単語に相応しい外見――
lines.english: Kobato went skipping merrily away, the very picture of wholesome innocence—

lines.japanese: あっ！　甘ったるそうなイチゴセーキ見ながら悩んでる！　しまった中身も外見相応だった。甘いものって俺たちくらいになればミルクティーなんかを指すと思ってたんだけど……。
lines.english: Ah! She was eyeing that sickly-sweet strawberry shake and wavering! Damn it, the inside matched the outside. I'd thought that by our age, 'something sweet' meant milk tea or the like...

lines.japanese: ああ手がイチゴセーキに伸びた！　やばい、止めに入らねば！
lines.english: Her hand was reaching for the strawberry shake! This was bad. I had to intervene!

lines.japanese: 俺が自動販売機に向かって走りかけたそのときだった。
lines.english: I had just started to charge toward the vending machine when it happened.

lines.japanese: 「隼人くんめーっけ！」
lines.english: “Fooound you, Hayato!”

lines.japanese: 「へっ？」
lines.english: “Huh?”

lines.japanese: 疾風のように一つの影が飛びこんできた。
lines.english: A shadow came hurtling in like a gale.

lines.japanese: 「やっひー！　なにしてんのっ！」
lines.english: “Hiya! Whatcha doing?”

lines.japanese: 「えええっ！？」
lines.english: “Whaaat!?”

lines.japanese: 香田が周囲を全く気にせず飛びついてきた。なだらかな硬い感触。久しぶりだった。
lines.english: Koda threw herself at me without the slightest concern for our surroundings. A gently rounded firmness. It had been a while.

lines.japanese: 「じゃなくていきなり何してくれてんだ、ぱじゅかしくないのか貴様。プッ殺すぞコノヤロウ」
lines.english: “I mean—what the hell are you doing, jumping me like that? A-aren't you embarrassed? I'll friggin' kill you, asshole!”

lines.japanese: ぐっ、しまった。つい動揺して、さんざ言いなれていたはずのフレーズまで噛んでしまった。
lines.english: Damn it. She had rattled me so badly that I stumbled over a phrase I must have said a thousand times.

lines.japanese: 「だって隼人君、私に会うとガン逃げすんしー。ソッコーで捕まえんとね」
lines.english: “You always bolt like hell when you see me, Hayato. Gotta catch you on the spot, right?”

lines.japanese: 「やめなさい、年頃の娘さんがはしたない。ほらご通行中の皆さんも見てるだろ」
lines.english: “Stop that. A young lady your age should have some decency. Look—everybody passing by is staring.”

lines.japanese: 「みんな応援ありがとー！」
lines.english: “Thanks for cheering us on, everybody!”

lines.japanese: 「アレっ！？　ここでポジティブシンキングいりませんよね！？」
lines.english: “What!? Now is not the time for positive thinking!”

lines.japanese: つくづく前向きな女だ。こいつには言葉じゃ通じそうもない。こうなったら実力行使もやむなし。
lines.english: She was relentlessly positive. Words clearly weren't going to reach her. That left me no choice but to resort to force.

lines.japanese: 「ええい離せ小娘、さもないと貴様の純情可憐な蕾を毟りとるぞ」
lines.english: “Unhand me, little girl, or I shall pluck the pure and tender bud of your maidenhood.”

lines.japanese: 「うんいいよ。なにするん？」
lines.english: “Sure, okay. Whatcha gonna do?”

lines.japanese: 「あ、ごめんなさい、やっぱり今のナシ」
lines.english: “Oh. Sorry. Forget I said that.”

lines.japanese: 俺は頭と片手の動きで仕切り直しのボディランゲージを表した。
lines.english: I shook my head and swept one hand through the air, signaling a reset.

lines.japanese: 「ええい離せ小娘、痛い目みせるぞコノヤロウ」
lines.english: “Unhand me, little girl, or I'll make you regret it, asshole.”

lines.japanese: 「やーん、こんなところで隼人君ドＳー。うんでも隼人君のためなら耐えられゆ。どぞ」
lines.english: “Oh nooo, Hayato's going full sadist right here in public. But if it's for you, I can take it. Go ahead.”

lines.japanese: やつは目を閉じて頭を差しだしてきた。チョップの嵐をお見舞いしようかと思ったが、ここで手を出したら負けだと思って昂ぶる我が手を抑えた。
lines.english: She closed her eyes and offered me her head. I considered raining chops upon it, but striking her now would mean defeat, so I restrained my surging hand.

lines.japanese: 「ていうかＭって無敵じゃん！」
lines.english: “Wait! Masochists are invincible!”

lines.japanese: 「はーい、はーい、今日から亜衣ぽんドＭー！」
lines.english: “Me, me! Starting today, Ai is a total masochist!”

lines.japanese: 「おい、おい香田。悪いが今は本当に遊んでやれないのだ。今度あったときにどこでも付き合うから今日だけはカンベンしてください」
lines.english: “Listen, Koda. Sorry, but I genuinely can't play with you right now. Next time we meet, I'll go anywhere you want, so please—just give me a break today.”

lines.japanese: 「マジで！」
lines.english: “Seriously?!”

lines.japanese: 俺が懐柔策を計ると、香田はあっさりと手を離した。
lines.english: The moment I tried appeasement, Koda released me without a struggle.

lines.japanese: 「へへー、隼人君と遊ぶ約束しちった」
lines.english: “Hee hee. Got Hayato to promise me a date.”

lines.japanese: 「約束っていうより脅迫だろ……」
lines.english: “That was less a promise than extortion...”

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ今日は忙しいみたいだから帰るね。そんじゃ！」
lines.english: “Well, you look busy today, so I'll head home. See ya!”

lines.japanese: 毎日忙しいっつーの。と言おうとしたけど、その時にはすでに香田の姿は見えなくなっていた。
lines.english: I'm busy every day, I started to say, but by then Koda had already vanished.

lines.japanese: 「けっこんおぜんていとした？」
lines.english: “Was it for getting maaaarried?”

lines.japanese: 「あ、小鳩」
lines.english: “Oh. Kobato.”

lines.japanese: 「どこまで？」
lines.english: “How far?”

lines.japanese: 「小鳩、おまえはカン違いをしている。さっきのひとは自分がコアラだと思いこんでる、ちょっと夢見がちなひとなんだ。だから許してあげなさい」
lines.english: “Kobato, you misunderstand. That woman is a bit of a dreamer who believes she's a koala. You must forgive her.”

lines.japanese: 「ひ、ひとはウソをつくとき、じょうぜつになります」
lines.english: “P-people become very eloquent when they're lying.”

lines.japanese: 「えいっ」
lines.english: “Take that.”

lines.japanese: むにっ
lines.english: Squish.

lines.japanese: 「ひょ、ひょめんなふぁい」
lines.english: “I-I’m shorry.”

lines.japanese: 俺は小鳩のほっぺたを両側に引っぱって力技でごまかした。
lines.english: I took Kobato’s cheeks in both hands and pulled, using brute force to change the subject.

lines.japanese: 女の嫉妬なんて気にしてたらキリがない。たまにはこうしてごまかさないとやってられない。
lines.english: If I worried about every girl’s jealousy, I’d never hear the end of it. Sometimes you just had to distract them.

lines.japanese: え、やきもちなのこれ？
lines.english: Wait. Was this jealousy?

lines.japanese: 「あ～らドラちゃん、見てたわよ。楽しそうで何よりねえ」
lines.english: “My, my, Dra darling. I saw the whole thing. You certainly looked as though you were enjoying yourself.”

lines.japanese: こっ恥ずかしい真似をしてしまったので駅前広場からさっさと出ようと思ったら、自分の露店を離れていかついのが話しかけてきた。
lines.english: After making such a mortifying spectacle of myself, I meant to hurry out of the station plaza. Then an imposing figure abandoned his stall and called to me.

lines.japanese: 「おおマルチネス、久しぶり。元気？」
lines.english: “Oh, Martinez. Long time no see. How've you been?”

lines.japanese: 「えっ」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese: 驚いてる。まあそりゃ兄の知人がオネエ言葉使う外国籍の男だったらびっくりするわな。
lines.english: She was startled. Fair enough. Anyone would be surprised to learn that her brother's acquaintance was a foreign man speaking in a camp feminine cadence.

lines.japanese: 「心配しないでいいぞ小鳩。コレはキモイけど、意外と噛んだりしないから。害はキモイだけだ」
lines.english: “Don't worry, Kobato. This thing may be creepy, but surprisingly, it doesn't bite. The creepiness is the only harm.”

lines.japanese: 「あら、かわいいお嬢ちゃんねえ。なあに、どうやったらドラちゃんみたいに毎日違う女を連れて歩けるのよぉ」
lines.english: “Oh, what an adorable young lady. Tell me, Dra darling, how do you manage to parade around with a different woman every day?”
“Huh?”

lines.japanese: 「いや、違うからな。それは俺じゃなくて隼人のことだからな」
lines.english: “No, you've got it wrong. He means Hayato, not me.”

lines.japanese: 「そんなに女の子にモテたいなら、アクセサリーの一つでも付けたらどうなのよ。今なら久しぶりに会った記念に半額で売ってあげても構わないわよ」
lines.english: “If you want the girls swooning over you that badly, why not wear a little jewelry? In honor of our reunion, I might even be persuaded to let you have something for half price.”

lines.japanese: 「そのブレスレット、元の値段が半額以下だろうが。そんなもん誰が買うんだよ」
lines.english: “That bracelet wasn't worth half the price to begin with. Who the hell would buy it?”

lines.japanese: 「大丈夫、ヤマト民族はみんなイエスマンだから。どう、買うの買わないの」
lines.english: “Don't you worry. The Yamato people are all yes-men. Well? Are you buying or aren't you?”

lines.japanese: 「いやイエスマンの意味間違ってるから。いいから、いいからその手に持ったブレスレットしまいなさい」
lines.english: “That isn't what *yes-man* means. Come on now, put that bracelet away.”

lines.japanese: 「ドラちゃんには言ってないわ、アタシが話してるのはこっちのかわいらしいお嬢ちゃんよ」
lines.english: “I wasn't speaking to *you*, Dra darling. I'm talking to this adorable young lady here.”

lines.japanese: 「はっ！　いい、いえ、ヤマト民族基準ではかわいくなんかないです」
lines.english: “Oh! N-no. By Yamato standards, I'm not adorable at all.”

lines.japanese: 「一般的にかわいいといわれるのは、そちらにいる女の子のようなお人形さんのことです」
lines.english: “A girl people would ordinarily call adorable is a little doll like that one over there.”

lines.japanese: 「ああアリスも久しぶり。元気？」
lines.english: “Oh, Alice. Long time no see. You doing well?”

lines.japanese: 「ほんものっ！？　お、お人形さんかと思った……」
lines.english: “She's real!? I-I thought she was a doll...”

lines.japanese: 「ああら、ずいぶん嬉しいこと言ってくれるじゃない。アリス、ドラちゃんの雌猫にご挨拶なさいよ」
lines.english: “Oh my, what a delightful thing to say. Alice, come and say hello to Dra darling's little kitten.”

lines.japanese: 「は、はじめましてー」
lines.english: “N-nice to meet you.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、えっと」
lines.english: “Oh, um...”

lines.japanese: 「Ｓｏｒｒｙ，Ｉ　ｃａｎ’ｔ　ｓｐｅａｋ　Ｊａｐａｎｅｓｅ」
lines.english: “Sorry, I can't speak Japanese.”

lines.japanese: 「あ……ごめんなさい、英語はわかりません」
lines.english: “Oh... I'm sorry. I don't understand English.”

lines.japanese: 二人のやり取りを傍から見ていた俺は、口を挟まずに黙っていた。なんとなく。
lines.english: I watched their exchange from the sidelines and said nothing. It simply felt like I shouldn't.

lines.japanese: 隣を見るとマルチネスも困ったような笑いを浮かべてる。だからまあ、なにも言うべきじゃないんだろう。
lines.english: Beside me, Martinez wore a troubled smile. So yes, there was probably nothing either of us ought to say.

lines.japanese: 「いや～、参ったなあ。今日は何度声をかけても上手くいかないし、しばらく休憩しようかなあ」
lines.english: “Man, this is rough. No matter how many girls I approach today, nothing works. Maybe I'll take a break.”

lines.japanese: 「あっ、ドラさん！　いつの間に来てたんですか！」
lines.english: “Oh! Dra! When did you get here?”

lines.japanese: 「やあこんにちは。女の子以外は視界にも入りませんかこんにちは」
lines.english: “Why, good afternoon. I see anyone who isn't a girl still fails to enter your field of vision. Good afternoon.”

lines.japanese: 「ははっ、やだなあ、本当に気づかなかったんですよ。ごめんなさい」
lines.english: “Ha ha! Oh, come on. I honestly didn't notice you. Sorry about that.”

lines.japanese: ウソだ。職業柄、この広場の中で誰が何をしているかの空間把握能力をこの男は持っている。おそらく俺が亜衣に抱きつかれた辺りから見てたくせに、助け舟も出さずに放置してたんだろう。
lines.english: A lie. His profession had given him a perfect spatial sense for who was doing what throughout this plaza. He had probably been watching since Ai threw herself at me, and simply stood by without offering a lifeline.

lines.japanese: でもこんな爽やかな笑顔で謝られるとこっちも強く出られない。それも分かってやってんだろうから、俺は鳩尾にえぐりこむようなボディブロウ一発でカンベンしてやった。
lines.english: But it was hard to stay angry when he apologized with that breezy smile. He knew it, too, so I let him off with a punch driven deep into the pit of his stomach.

lines.japanese: 「ところで見かけない顔の女の子が一人いますね」
lines.english: “By the way, there's one girl here I don't recognize.”

lines.japanese: 「はっ！　ドラさん、またしても小さい女の子を……」
lines.english: “What! Dra, not another little girl...”

lines.japanese: 「親戚だ親戚」
lines.english: “She's family. Family.”

lines.japanese: 「どう思うマルチネス」
lines.english: “What do you think, Martinez?”

lines.japanese: 「身内、体調、交通機関は日本人がする言い訳の三大要素だわ」
lines.english: “Family, illness, and public transportation: the three essential ingredients in any Japanese excuse.”

lines.japanese: 「うるさい、真実はもっと奥深いんだよ」
lines.english: “Shut up. The truth goes deeper than that.”

lines.japanese: 「ていうかおまえらキャラが濃いんだよ。見ろ、いたいけな少女が脅えてしまったじゃないか」
lines.english: “Besides, you people are too much. Look—you've frightened this innocent young girl.”
“'You people'?”

lines.japanese: 「いいいえ、おびえてないです。おともだちが多いのはいいことです」
lines.english: “N-no, I'm not frightened. Having lots of friends is a good thing.”

lines.japanese: 小鳩がチラとアリスを見た。目が合ったように見えたけど、アリスはマルチネスのジャージの影に隠れているからよく分からない。
lines.english: Kobato flicked a glance at Alice. Their eyes seemed to meet, though Alice was hiding behind Martinez's tracksuit, so I couldn't be sure.

lines.japanese: 「あ、ええっとこういうとき英語ではなんていうのかな、あはは……」
lines.english: “Oh, um... What do you say in English at a time like this? Ha ha...”

lines.japanese: 「マルチネス、通訳してやってくれない？」
lines.english: “Martinez, would you interpret for them?”

lines.japanese: 「オーケイ」
lines.english: “Okay.”

lines.japanese: やつは俺たちには聞き取れない言語でアリスになにかしゃべりかけた。これならアリスも逃げられないだろう。
lines.english: He said something to Alice in a language none of us could understand. Now she had nowhere left to run.

lines.japanese: だがプライドの高いお嬢様はそっぽを向いて答えなかった。難しい年頃みたいだ。
lines.english: But the proud young lady turned away and refused to answer. A difficult age, apparently.

lines.japanese: 「あのね、日本では類は友を呼ぶって言うんだよ」
lines.english: “You know, in Japan we say that birds of a feather flock together.”
“'The same kind'!?”

lines.japanese: でも小鳩も挫けなかった。もしかして俺の知り合いだから気を使ってくれたのかな。
lines.english: But Kobato refused to give up. Perhaps she was making the effort because these were acquaintances of mine.

lines.japanese: 「罵らないでください。私は知っている、それを呼ぶ言葉『ハキダメ』」
lines.english: “Please not insult me. I know. The word for calling that is ‘garbage heap.’”

lines.japanese: 「すると私は鶴だ」
lines.english: “Then I’m the crane in the garbage heap.”

lines.japanese: 「わあアリスちゃんむずかしい言葉も知ってるんだねー」
lines.english: “Wow, Alice! You know such difficult words!”

lines.japanese: 「はい。大したことだ」
lines.english: “Yes. It is very impressive.”

lines.japanese: 「いいんですかドラさん」
lines.english: “You're all right with that, Dra?”

lines.japanese: 「まあ間違ってはないしいいんじゃないか」
lines.english: “Well, she isn't wrong. I suppose it's fine.”

lines.japanese: 「なるほど。ではドラさんの楽しみを邪魔しても悪いですし、僕は仕事に戻ります。ねーねー、そこのおねえさあーん！」
lines.english: “I see. Then I'd hate to interrupt Dra's fun, so I'll get back to work. Heeey, miss! Yes, you there!”

lines.japanese: 失礼なことを言ったくせに、こっちにツッコミを入れさせる余裕を見せずにスカウトマンは去っていった。次に会ったときはあいつのケータイから「出家しました」のメールをメモリ内のアドレスに一斉送信してやる。
lines.english: After insulting me, the scout left without giving me a chance to answer back. Next time I saw him, I’d take his phone and text everyone in his contacts: “I’ve become a monk.”

lines.japanese: 「ただいま戻りました」
lines.english: “I'm back.”

lines.japanese: 「早いな！」
lines.english: “That was fast!”

lines.japanese: 「いやそれが声をかけた女性が……」
lines.english: “Well, you see, the woman I approached...”

lines.japanese: 「よぅ、ドラ！　あたし今プラチナに声かけられちったィ！」
lines.english: “Yo, Dra! Platinum just tried to pick me up!”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、ああぁ……」
lines.english: “Oh. Ohhh...”

lines.japanese: 後姿とはいえ、女性の選別を誤るのはプラチナにとって最大級の屈辱だろう。追い討ちをかけるのが不憫になったから、背中を撫でてやった。
lines.english: Even from behind, failing to identify a woman correctly must have been humiliation on the grandest possible scale for Platinum. I felt too sorry for him to pile on, so I stroked his back.

lines.japanese: 「いやいやプラチナ、あんた人を見る目が上がったんじゃないか？　それともあたしが綺麗になったのかね、アハハッ」
lines.english: “Now, now, Platinum. Maybe you've finally developed an eye for quality. Or maybe I'm getting prettier! Ha ha!”

lines.japanese: 「テンション高いなあ……」
lines.english: “You're certainly in high spirits...”

lines.japanese: 「なんだってェ？　相変わらず湿っぽい男だなァ。まッ！　今日はあたしが若い子連れてきてやったから、それでテンション上げな」
lines.english: “What was that? Still the same gloomy man, I see. Well! I brought a young girl along today. Let her put some pep in you.”

lines.japanese: 「若い子？」
lines.english: “A young girl?”

lines.japanese: 「ギャルですか！？　どこですか、ギャールッ！　ギャールッ！」
lines.english: “A gal!? Where? Gaaal! Gaaal!”

lines.japanese: 「ははっ、実はあたしだって言ったらどうする？」
lines.english: “Ha ha! What would you do if I said I meant me?”

lines.japanese: 「ええー」
lines.english: “Ewww.”

lines.japanese: 「ドラ、あたしはちょいと野暮用が出来たからこの子の相手してやっとくれ」
lines.english: “Dra, a little business just came up. Keep this girl company for me.”

lines.japanese: プラチナはパルさんの野暮用と共に姿を消した。まあ自業自得だしほっとこう。
lines.english: Platinum disappeared together with Paru's little piece of business. He had brought it upon himself, so I left him to his fate.

lines.japanese: 「で、ギャルって誰だよ。ちょっとシャイな俺からすると初対面の女の子なんて、て、照れちゃうじゃないか」
lines.english: “So who's this gal? I'm rather shy, you know. A girl I've never met before makes me, er... makes me blush.”

lines.japanese: 「あー、ドラさんどーもー。ご紹介にあずかりましたギャルですー」
lines.english: “Ah, hello, Dra. I am the gal to whom you have just been introduced.”

lines.japanese: 「おまえかよ」
lines.english: “It's *you*?”

lines.japanese: パルさんの後ろに見えていたので一通りのボケをワンセットやってみた。お互いに満足できてすっきりした。
lines.english: I had seen her behind Paru all along, so we played out the whole routine for form's sake. We both emerged satisfied and refreshed.

lines.japanese: 「あ、鳴ちゃんさん」
lines.english: “Oh! Miss Naru.”

lines.japanese: 「あれー、キューちゃーん？」
lines.english: “Huh? Kyuu?”

lines.japanese: 「はっ？」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese: 知り合い？
lines.english: They knew each other?

lines.japanese: 「あ、えええっと、図書館友達の鳳鳴ちゃんさん」
lines.english: “Oh, um, this is Naru Otori. We're library friends.”

lines.japanese: 「あー、ドラさんどーもー。ご紹介にあずかりましたナルですー」
lines.english: “Ah, hello, Dra. I am the Naru to whom you have just been introduced.”

lines.japanese: 「もういいよ」
lines.english: “We've done this already.”

lines.japanese: 「はー、それにしてもドラさんとキューちゃんが知り合いだったことにビックリですー。世界って狭いんですねー」
lines.english: “Wow, I can't believe you and Kyuu know each other, Dra. It really is a small world.”

lines.japanese: 「俺のセリフとるなよ。図書館で知り合ったって言うけど、どういう話をしたら繋がるのか分からん」
lines.english: “Don't steal my line. You say you met at the library, but I can't imagine how you two found enough to talk about to become friends.”

lines.japanese: 「はー、それは何度か顔を合わせていると自然と挨拶もするようになってくるものでー」
lines.english: “Well, after you see somebody there a few times, you naturally begin exchanging greetings—”

lines.japanese: 「それに私と結構共通点もありましてー、私にも兄がいるんですけど、キューちゃんも大好きなお兄さんがいるみたいでー」
lines.english: “and we have quite a few things in common. I have a big brother too, and Kyuu apparently has a big brother she absolutely adores—”

lines.japanese: 「な、なに？」
lines.english: “W-what?”

lines.japanese: 「わあっ」
lines.english: “Wah!”

lines.japanese: 小鳩が両手でホーメイの口を押さえた。
lines.english: Kobato clapped both hands over Homei's mouth.

lines.japanese: 「な、なに今の。もっかい今のトコ詳しく教えて」
lines.english: “W-what was that? Go back and explain that part in detail.”

lines.japanese: 「ふがー……えーと、キューちゃんにお兄さんがいるのはご存知でしょうかー、ふがふがー」
lines.english: “Mmph... Um, are you aware that Kyuu has a big brother? Mmph mmph.”

lines.japanese: 「し、知ってる、超知ってる」
lines.english: “I-I know. I know *extremely* well.”

lines.japanese: 「お、おわり、この話おわりっ」
lines.english: “Th-that's enough! This conversation is over!”

lines.japanese: 「ふががー、キューちゃんはお兄さんが大好きらしくてよく私にお兄さんのことをふがふがふがー」
lines.english: “Mmph mmph—Kyuu apparently adores her big brother, and she often tells me all about him, mmph mmph mmph—”

lines.japanese: 「そ、そこ、そこ詳しくっ！」
lines.english: “Th-that part! Explain that part!”

lines.japanese: 「それよりこれっ、この、こここのアクセサリー鳴ちゃんさんに似合うっ」
lines.english: “Never mind! Th-this, this—this accessory would look wonderful on you, Miss Naru!”

lines.japanese: 「ああら！　あなた見る目あるわあ、この妖艶な色香を漂わせる美女にピッタリよねえ？」
lines.english: “Oh my! You certainly have an eye, darling. It's perfect for a beauty positively wreathed in seductive allure, don't you think?”

lines.japanese: 「……なんですと？」
lines.english: “...Come again?”

lines.japanese: 「ま、待て、そこで話を止めるな！　止めるなちんちく小娘！」
lines.english: “W-wait! Don’t stop there! Tell me the rest, you pint-sized brat!”

lines.japanese: 「わー、このネックレスかわいいー、アトラクティブなセンスがきらりとさり気なく小規模爆発ー」
lines.english: “Wow, what a cute necklace. Its attractive style sparkles with a subtle, tastefully contained explosion.”

lines.japanese: 「お願い聞いて！　欲しいなら買ってあげてもいいからソレ！」
lines.english: “Please, listen! If you want that thing, I'll even buy it for you!”

lines.japanese: 「あいえ、グローバルな視点から見て需要があることは認めますけど、私は欲しくありませんねー」
lines.english: “Oh, no. I admit there must be demand for it from a global perspective, but I don't personally want one.”

lines.japanese: 「まあ、あと一押しなのに！　理由はどうあれ、ドラちゃんが私の作品に代金を払う最後のチャンスかもしれないわ。アリス、あなたからもプッシュしなさい」
lines.english: “My, just one more push! Whatever the reason, this may be my last chance to make Dra darling pay for one of my creations. Alice, you push her too.”

lines.japanese: 「Ｕｈ……Ｉ　ｄｏｎ’ｔ　ｕｎｄｅｒｓｔａｎｄ　Ｊａｐａｎｅｓｅ」
lines.english: “Uh... I don't understand Japanese.”

lines.japanese: マルチネスの説得にも関わらず、まだアリスは知らない日本人がいることが怖いみたいだ。
lines.english: Despite Martinez's coaxing, Alice still seemed frightened by the unfamiliar Japanese people around her.

lines.japanese: すると鳴がアリスと同じ言語で横から一言発した。アリスはその蒼い目をぱちくりさせた。
lines.english: Then Naru cut in with a few words in Alice's own language. Alice blinked her blue eyes.

lines.japanese: そこからしばらく俺と小鳩には聞きとれない言語での会話が三人で行われた。俺と小鳩は苦笑いしながら顔を見合わせた。だってなに言ってるか分からないんだもん。
lines.english: The three of them proceeded to converse for a while in a language neither Kobato nor I could follow. Kobato and I exchanged rueful smiles. What else could we do? We had no clue what they were saying.

lines.japanese: 「あれー、どうしたんですかー。お二人も話に加わってください、さあさあ」
lines.english: “Hmm? What's wrong? You two should join the conversation. Come, come.”

lines.japanese: 「ちなみにいま何の話してんの？」
lines.english: “So what are you guys talking about?”

lines.japanese: 「はあ……ドラさんにこのブレスレットを買わせるための打ち合わせですねー」
lines.english: “Well... we're coordinating our efforts to make you buy this bracelet, Dra.”

lines.japanese: 俺は縦型チョップでそのブレスレットを打ちおとした。マルチネスが慌てて拾いあげて俺に何か文句を言ったが違う言語なんで分からないフリをした。
lines.english: I knocked the bracelet out of his hand with a vertical chop. Martinez hurriedly retrieved it and complained to me, but he did so in another language, so I pretended not to understand.

lines.japanese: 「鳴ちゃんさん、すごいです。英語を話せるんですか」
lines.english: “Miss Naru, that's amazing. You speak English?”

lines.japanese: 「はっ。あ、いや、ホントにそんなすごいものじゃなくて、ええ、もうホントに」
lines.english: “Hah! Oh—no, it really isn't anything impressive. Honestly. It really isn't.”

lines.japanese: 「いや凄いことにしろ。でないと理解出来ない俺たちの位置が危うい」
lines.english: “No, make it impressive. Otherwise those of us who can't understand a word are going to look pretty bad.”

lines.japanese: 「や、や、そんなたまたま一時期海外に居ただけなんで、ホントに大したことないんですはい。方言みたいなものです」
lines.english: “N-no, no. I only happened to live abroad for a while. It truly isn't a big deal. Yes. Think of it as a dialect.”

lines.japanese: 「鳴は話が分かる。なぜならヨーエンなイロカのただようオンナだからだ」
lines.english: “Naru understands. This is because she is a woman who exudes SEDUCTIVE ALLURE.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、そーですー、大人の女ということなんですねー」
lines.english: “Oh, precisely. That means I'm a grown woman.”

lines.japanese: 「多分それアリスの言語に訳したら鼻で笑われると思うけど」
lines.english: “I suspect she'd snort at you if you translated that back into her language.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、でもこれで鳴ちゃんさんに通訳してもらえば、私もアリスちゃんとお話できるねっ」
lines.english: “Oh, but now Miss Naru can interpret for us, so I can talk to Alice too!”

lines.japanese: 小鳩が今度こそとアリスに声をかけた。言ってみりゃ王手だ。
lines.english: Kobato tried Alice again, determined to make it work this time. You might call it checkmate.

lines.japanese: 「そ、そんなものは必要ない」
lines.english: “Th-there is no need for that.”

lines.japanese: でもプライドの高いお嬢ちゃんは最後まで意地を張った。
lines.english: But the proud little lady remained stubborn to the bitter end.

lines.japanese: 「なぜなら私はあなたたちを試していたにすぎない。私が本気を出せば日本語をたびたび理解できるだろう」
lines.english: “Because I was merely testing all of you. If I become serious, I will understand Japanese from time to time.”

lines.japanese: 「わあ、じゃあアリスちゃんもよーえんないろかのなんとか女？」
lines.english: “Wow! Then are you one of those seductive-allure-something women too, Alice?”

lines.japanese: 「はい、そうだ」
lines.english: “Yes. That is correct.”

lines.japanese: 胸を反って堂々の返事。でもきちんと面と向かいあって話している。アリスも小鳩に心を開きだしたみたいだ。
lines.english: She thrust out her chest and answered with dignity. But she was speaking to Kobato properly, face-to-face. It seemed Alice was beginning to open up to her.

lines.japanese: 「おっ、なんだいなんだい、盛り上がってるじゃないか。よし、そいじゃこれから、メンマの店にでもみんなで行くかい？」
lines.english: “Oh? What's all this? You're having quite a time, aren't you? Right, then! Why don't we all head over to Menma's place?”

lines.japanese: 「おっ、パルさんとプラチナ。おかえり」
lines.english: “Oh, Paru and Platinum. Welcome back.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、あの、僕まだ仕事中なんですってば」
lines.english: “Um, I'm still supposed to be working.”

lines.japanese: 「やかあしい！　四の五の言ってっと、そのもやしみたいな体へし折ってラーメンの中にたたっ込むよ！」
lines.english: “Shut your yap! Keep arguing and I'll snap that bean-sprout body of yours in half and stuff it into a bowl of noodles!”

lines.japanese: 俺たちは昼食をまだ済ませてないことに気づいて、パルさんたちにくっついてメンマのラーメン屋に行った。
lines.english: We realized we still hadn't eaten lunch and tagged along with Paru and the others to Menma's noodle shop.

lines.japanese: その後は結局暗くなるまで話しこんで、閉店寸前のデパートで買い物を済ませた。
lines.english: In the end, we sat talking until dark, then bought the gift at a department store moments before it closed.
